author: The Current
description:
Ed Jurdi and Gordy Quist from The Band of Heathens talk about "Take the Cake"
Support The Current: https://support.mpr.org/youtube or hit the Thanks button

Austin, Texas, act The Band of Heathens have been together for 20 years, and their recent single, "Take the Cake," from their latest album, "Country Sides," reached No. 1 in the Americana charts. During an interview with The Current's Bill DeVille, The Band of Heathens co-founders and songwriters Ed Jurdi and Gordy Quist talk about "Take the Cake" — about how it feels to have a No. 1 song and about what inspired it.
